mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate over three consecutive months signals a tightening monetary policy stance, raising discount rates and reducing present value of future corporate cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of episodes where FEDFUNDS rises for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the unemployment rate below 4% for two consecutive months indicates a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately reducing corporate profit margins and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE falls below 4% for two consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals weakening aggregate demand, which reduces corporate revenue growth and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of episodes where GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained contraction in industrial production (INDPRO) below its 12-month moving average for six consecutive months indicates supply-side weakness, which increases input costs and reduces profit margins, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO < 12-month moving average for six consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when INDPRO is below its 12-month moving average for six months.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous and persistent rise in both the federal funds rate and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals a dual tightening of monetary policy and inflation, which erodes real purchasing power and depresses equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL both rise for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of episodes where both FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL rise for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated rise in both personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) and housing starts (HOUST) above their respective 12-month moving averages for three consecutive months signals robust aggregate demand, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 and HOUST both above 12-month moving average for three consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when both GDPC1 and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages for three months.

mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above the 12-month moving average for five consecutive months, combined with a stable unemployment rate, indicates strong labor market absorption without overheating, which supports corporate profit growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS > 12-month moving average for five consecutive months and UNRATE stable
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher (t-test p > 0.05) during periods when PAYEMS is above its 12-month moving average for five months and UNRATE is stable.

mechanism_narrative: Real personal savings (RSAFS) persistently below its 10-year average for more than one year signals a chronic savings shortfall, which reduces households' capacity to finance consumption and investment, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS < 10-year average for more than one year
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of episodes where RSAFS remains below its 10-year average for more than one year.
